title: Ask a question and score it
blurb: A real quiz question, with a reply for every answer and a score at the end.
how: QUESTION describes one question: the prompt, and a list of options. One option has "correct": True.
Every option has a reply. That's what the player sees after they answer, so a wrong answer still tells them something.
score = yield play("club_day", title="One question", items=[QUESTION]) runs it. The first name is your name for this activity. items is the list of questions.
score comes back as a number from 0 to 4. All right is 4. If the player closed the question without answering, it's None, so check for that first.
try: Rewrite the question about something you know is true about BLHS. Only put in facts you're sure of.
Add a second question. Make QUESTION2 the same way, give it a different id, and put both in items.
Give three different lines for a perfect score, a half score and zero.
breaks: Two options with the same id, or the question won't start
Every question needs its own id. Copying a question and forgetting to change the id is the usual cause.
